title: PluginRemovedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'plugin.removed'. Loombre Plugin Protocol (LPP) v1, Lane W2 (LD4): emitted in the SAME transaction as the plugins row DELETE (packages/db/src/query/plugins.ts's removePluginAndEmit; plugin_event_grants rows CASCADE with it). ADMIN-ONLY delivery, mirroring settings.updated exactly. Never carries the manifest, config, or any secret — the row (and any keyring entries the lifecycle service removes alongside this call) are gone by the time this event is observable.

pluginId.description: The plugins.id row that was removed.

name.description: The plugin's name at the time of removal.

removedAtMs.description: Epoch ms the row was deleted.
